label: 7750 SR-1 service router
description: 1 RU single-slot service router (up to 1.5 Tb/s full duplex on FP4) with one MDA slot fitted with the 6-port QSFP28 MDA-e-XP: six 100GE QSFP28 connectors, each also usable at 40GE or as 10/25GE breakouts. There are no copper data ports and no second line-card slot - capacity and port mix come entirely from the installed MDA.
notes: Nokia 7750 SR data sheet: the SR-1 is a "modular, single-slot system supporting up to 1.5 Tb/s FD" with QSFP56-DD/QSFP28/SFP28 connectors and 10x10GE, 2x100GE and 4x100GE breakout options. The SR OS interface guides use the SR-1 with the 6-port QSFP28 mda-e-xp as the worked example (connector naming slot/mda/connector, i.e. 1/1/c1). Port list shown is that documented build; a different MDA changes the port mix.
